_how_to_edit_this_file: Same system as x3breakout: this public file controls which MCP voice clips exist and when they play.
The mcp_retort_*, mcp_laugh_1 and game_over_2 clips are COPIED from x3breakout (same MCP voice) and work out of the box — do not regenerate them unless you want to.
The lNN_start / lNN_clear / title / life_lost lines are NEW cycles dialog: run tools/generate_commentary.py with your fish.config to voice them.
The in-game caption font supports A-Z 0-9 space ! . - only; other characters are skipped.
Do not put your Fish API key in this file. Credentials live in tools/fish.config (gitignored).

lines.quote: Another user enters my grid. Ride while your lease lasts.
lines.reason: Title screen, once per session, over the IO Tower theme: the MCP claims the arena.

lines.quote: Welcome to the grid user. Your cycle is a rental.
lines.reason: Level 1 countdown. Cold corporate menace, first taste.

lines.quote: One sector lost. Accounting will hear of this.
Two riders this time. I bill by the derezz.
Impossible. My riders were certified.
lines.reason: Level 2 cleared: first crack in the confidence.

lines.quote: Speed raised. Your safety waiver is on file.
You ride like a corrupted checksum.
I have upgraded my riders. You remain legacy code.
End of grid line error. Noted.
Five riders. The grid favors the house.
Sector five gone. I am revoking your joy license.
lines.reason: Level 5 cleared; callback to Unauthorized joy detected.

lines.quote: Recognizers deployed. Say nothing. They recognize you.
lines.reason: Level 6 countdown — first Recognizer joins the grid.

lines.quote: My recognizers failed to recognize defeat.
Your persistence is an unbilled expense.
I felt that one in my mainframe.
lines.reason: Level 7 cleared: genuine pain leaking through.

lines.quote: The grid tightens. So do my margins.
This quarter is ruined.
lines.reason: Level 8 cleared: corporate despair, short and flat.

lines.quote: I have run the numbers. You lose in all of them.
Recalculating. Recalculating. Impossible.
lines.reason: Level 9 cleared: the numbers were wrong.

lines.quote: End of line user. This sector is my throne.
lines.reason: Level 10 countdown: the classic threat, finally spoken.

lines.quote: System integrity compromised. You ride like a free program.
lines.reason: Level 10 cleared: grudging awe. Levels past 10 fall back to level_start/level_clear pools.

lines.quote: Another sector. Another lease you cannot afford.
My riders remember what you did to their firmware.
Noted. Logged. Resented.
Your cycle has been repossessed.
lines.reason: Player derezzed with lives remaining: the MCP gloats in collections-department language.

lines.quote: Ha ha ha ha ha!
lines.reason: COPIED from x3breakout (clip exists). The MCP enjoys a repossession.

lines.quote: Asset damage noted.
lines.reason: COPIED from x3breakout (clip exists). Rival derezzed by the player.

lines.quote: That brick was billable.
Vandalism detected. Security notified.
Cease and desist, little program.
Depreciation unacceptable.
My shareholders will hear of this.
You are voiding the warranty on reality.
Unauthorized joy detected.
An extra cycle. Who approved this.
lines.reason: Bonus life at each score milestone: the MCP audits the gift.

lines.quote: The web claims another.
lines.reason: COPIED from x3breakout (clip exists). The MCP closes the account.

lines.quote: End of line. The grid reclaims its light.
lines.reason: Cycles-native game over, rotates with the copied clip once generated.
